settings.chromeDesc: Let the AI work in your own Chrome (your sign-ins) through the pi extension. Turn on "My Chrome" in the composer Tools menu per conversation.
settings.chromeNotListening: Not listening (port busy?). Turn it off and on again.
settings.chromeStep1: In Chrome open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose "Load unpacked" and pick the extension folder.
settings.chromeStep2: Click the pi extension icon and paste the pairing code below.
settings.chromeStep3: In a conversation, turn on "My Chrome" in the composer Tools menu.
settings.chromeNote: While the AI works, Chrome shows a "being debugged" bar on its tabs. It only drives tabs in its own window or tabs you lend it.
settings.agentCdpDesc: Lets the AI reach into iframes, answer page dialogs, read request bodies, take full-page screenshots and emulate phones. Attached only to tabs the AI uses. Turn off if a site blocks automation.
settings.siteNotesDesc: Tricks the AI wrote down per site and reads back on later visits.
settings.title: Built-in browser
settings.description: Options for the Browser panel. Changes apply immediately.
settings.clearDataDesc: Removes cookies, sign-ins, cache and site storage kept by the built-in browser.
settings.clearDataConfirm: You will be signed out of every site in the built-in browser. Clear now?
settings.downloaderDesc: With aria2 installed, files download over several connections with the page's sign-in cookies; on failure the built-in downloader takes over.
settings.aria2Missing: aria2 not found; the built-in downloader is used. Install aria2 or pick aria2c.
settings.aria2Invalid: The chosen file cannot run; the built-in downloader is used.
